$comment: Generated from the Buildish Release Tooling Pydantic models. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with `make schemas`.
description: Action manifest emitted after summarizing ATR checks for one candidate revision. This command manifest is internal Buildish workflow I/O and is not a supported external API.

action.description: Stable command action identifier written by one Buildish command manifest.
action.title: Action

atr_base_url.description: Base ATR service URL that Buildish used for the related candidate upload or status query.
atr_base_url.title: Atr Base Url

atr_committee.description: ASF committee slug that Buildish reported to ATR for the related release candidate.
atr_committee.title: Atr Committee

atr_exception_count.description: Number of ATR checks that ended in an exception state for the related candidate or report.
atr_exception_count.title: Atr Exception Count

atr_failure_count.description: Number of ATR checks that reported a failing outcome for the related candidate or report.
atr_failure_count.title: Atr Failure Count

atr_latest_revision.description: Most recent ATR candidate revision known to Buildish when it emitted the related manifest or report.
atr_latest_revision.title: Atr Latest Revision

atr_phase.description: ATR publication phase that Buildish targeted or reported for the related candidate.
atr_phase.title: Atr Phase

atr_project.description: ATR project or product-line identifier that Buildish reported for the related release candidate.
atr_project.title: Atr Project

atr_reported_revision.description: ATR candidate revision that Buildish specifically reported in the related checks summary.
atr_reported_revision.title: Atr Reported Revision

atr_success_count.description: Number of ATR checks that reported success for the related candidate or report.
atr_success_count.title: Atr Success Count

atr_total_checks.description: Total number of ATR checks observed for the related candidate revision.
atr_total_checks.title: Atr Total Checks

atr_warning_count.description: Number of ATR checks that reported warnings for the related candidate or report.
atr_warning_count.title: Atr Warning Count

component.description: Component identifier for the Buildish command manifest or emitted action record.
component.title: Component

rc_tag.description: Exact RC Git tag, including the leading `v` prefix and `-rcN` suffix.
rc_tag.title: Rc Tag

strict_checking.description: Whether the related check or reporting step should fail the command when warnings or failures are present.
strict_checking.title: Strict Checking

version.description: Release version string without a leading `v` prefix.
version.title: Version

would_block_release.description: Whether the related check result would block release publication under the requested strictness policy.
would_block_release.title: Would Block Release

title: Buildish Release Tooling ReportAtrChecksManifest

x-buildish-contract.summary: Internal unstable JSON action manifest emitted by `report-atr-checks`.
